data.title: CSPC’s ADC SYS6010 Wins Breakthrough Status in China for Hard-to-Treat Lung Cancer
data.description:
CSPC Pharmaceutical Group ( (HK:1093) ) has provided an update.

CSPC Pharmaceutical Group announced that its antibody-drug conjugate SYS6010 has received Breakthrough Therapy Designation from China’s National Medical Products Administration for recurrent or metastatic actionable genomic alteration-negative non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer that has failed prior immunotherapy and platinum-based chemotherapy. The EGFR-targeting therapy has shown significantly superior efficacy to standard second-line chemotherapy, including more than doubling progression-free survival, and is currently being evaluated in a Phase III trial as monotherapy in this hard-to-treat patient group.

The designation underscores SYS6010’s potential clinical and commercial significance in a large lung cancer segment with limited effective options, where NSCLC accounts for about 85% of cases and a substantial share is genomic alteration-negative. SYS6010 has already secured three other Breakthrough Therapy Designations in China for various advanced solid tumors, reinforcing CSPC’s standing as an emerging leader in innovative oncology treatments and signaling meaningful implications for patients, healthcare providers and the company’s growth trajectory.

data.title: Nipro Nearly Completes Conversion of 2026 Euro-Yen Convertible Bonds
data.description:
Nipro ( (JP:8086) ) has shared an update.

Nipro Corporation has announced the near-complete conversion of its Euro-Yen Denominated Convertible Bonds due 2026, originally issued in September 2021 with a total principal of 30,000 million yen. Bondholders exercised conversion rights on 29,930 million yen, representing a 99.8% conversion ratio, with the remaining 70 million yen to be redeemed at par on the September 25, 2026 maturity date.

The conversions resulted in the delivery of 20,930,064 common shares, of which 7,657,338 came from treasury stock and 13,272,726 were newly issued, bringing share capital to 93,889,421,666 yen and total issued shares to 184,732,205 as of September 14, 2026. This move reduces interest-bearing debt and bolsters shareholders’ equity, strengthening Nipro’s financial foundation and potentially improving its balance sheet resilience for stakeholders ahead of the bond’s final redemption.

data.title: Erste Group to Coordinate Price Stabilisation for MOL’s EUR 500 Million Bond Issue
data.description:
Erste Group Bank ( (EBKOF) ) has shared an update.

Erste Group Bank AG, acting as stabilisation coordinator, has announced that it may conduct price‑support operations in connection with a planned EUR 500 million notes issuance by MOL Hungarian Oil and Gas Public Limited Company, with the securities expected to be due on 23 September 2031 and traded over the counter and on Euronext Dublin. The stabilisation period is set to begin on 15 September 2026, potentially running until 23 October 2026, during which Erste may over‑allot the bonds or execute transactions to support market pricing in line with EU market abuse and prospectus regulations, underscoring the structured nature of MOL’s financing and the regulated framework for investor protection.

The announcement clarifies that any stabilisation may not occur and, if undertaken, can be halted at any time, while emphasising that the communication is informational only and targeted at professional and qualified investors in the UK and EEA. By outlining the regulatory constraints and excluding retail and U.S. investors from the offer, Erste and MOL demonstrate adherence to cross‑border securities rules and highlight the focus on institutional capital, which may influence liquidity, pricing stability, and the investor base for the new bond.
